The sum of the known seven members is

\[
5+8+10+18+19+28+30 = 118
\]

So the sum of all eight members is

\[
118+x
\]

The mean is

\[
\frac{118+x}{8}
\]

The mean is 4.5 less than \(x\), so

\[
\frac{118+x}{8}=x-4.5
\]

Multiply both sides by 8:

\[
118+x=8x-36
\]

\[
154=7x
\]

\[
x=22
\]

The answer is 22.
